tasks.instruction: Overtime pay (15 per hour instead of 10) should start after 38 hours instead of after 40.
tasks.note: Changed constant inside a comparison chained with select.

tasks.instruction: Return 0 when the speed (first argument) is at or below the limit (second argument), 1 when it is at most 10 over the limit, and 2 otherwise; a speed exactly equal to the limit currently gets the wrong code.
tasks.note: Boundary at equality in the first of two chained selects.

tasks.instruction: Return bits 4 through 7 of the argument as a number from 0 to 15.
tasks.note: Mask is one bit too narrow; the wrong edit is one bit too wide.

tasks.instruction: Return true exactly when the value fits in 24 bits (is below 16777216).
tasks.note: Bool result; shift distance off by one.

tasks.instruction: Set to zero the slot just after the given index, wrapping from the last slot back to the first; the other slots stay unchanged.
Count the places where an element is smaller than the element just before it, looking only at the three neighbouring pairs (no wrap from the last element back to the first).
tasks.note: Fold count includes the wrap-around pair in start.

tasks.instruction: Members (the record's flag) should get ten per cent off (the discount rounded down) instead of twenty per cent; non-members pay the full price.
Return true when the yes votes (first argument) are at least two thirds of the total (second argument); exactly two thirds should pass.
tasks.note: Bool result; swapped constants in the wrong edit.

tasks.instruction: Adding 25 to the level (first argument) must not go over the capacity (second argument): when it would, return the capacity and true, otherwise the new level and false.
tasks.note: Record result built from a comparison chained with select.

tasks.instruction: Apply the bonus helper to each of the two scores separately and return the sum of the two bonused scores.
tasks.note: Helper call must be applied twice, not to the sum.

tasks.instruction: Drop the first element, move the others one place towards the front, and put the new value (second argument) in the last slot.
tasks.note: Array rebuilt with every element moving.

tasks.instruction: Return true when the start (first argument) is below the end (second argument) and the end is below 100.
tasks.note: Bool result with a new conjunct.

tasks.instruction: The function should return 2 when all three values are equal, 1 when exactly two are equal, and 0 when all differ; it currently misses one pair.
Return the position of the largest element; when the largest value appears more than once, return its first position.
tasks.note: Fold over a record state; ge picks the last tie.

tasks.instruction: Return the first element minus the second plus the third minus the fourth, with u32 wrapping.
Return the record's number with its top bit (bit 31) replaced by the record's flag: set when the flag is true, cleared when it is false.
tasks.note: Shift by 32 is a shift by 0 under the low-five-bits rule.
